subject.title: perf: avoid event-loop stall during embedded_run bootstrap-context

question: Should ordered agent:bootstrap hook handlers intentionally allow unrelated event-loop work to run between handlers?
rationale: The patch preserves registration order but changes the atomicity of mutations to a shared bootstrap event context, and current repository behavior does not establish that lifecycle policy.

options.title: Keep handler-chain atomic
options.body: Remove yieldBetweenHandlers while retaining asynchronous file reads, cooperative glob traversal, and bootstrap timing diagnostics.

options.title: Allow cooperative interleaving
options.body: Keep the yields and explicitly document and test that unrelated event-loop work may run between ordered bootstrap handlers.

recommendation.title: Keep handler-chain atomic
recommendation.body: Remove yieldBetweenHandlers while retaining asynchronous file reads, cooperative glob traversal, and bootstrap timing diagnostics.
